tool_input.command: cat PR.md && echo "---DIFF STAT---" && diffstat head.diff 2>/dev/null || wc -l head.diff
tool_input.description: Show PR description and diff size

result:
I've written the audit to `audit.md`. Summary:

**Verdict: CHANGES_REQUIRED** (1 High, 2 Medium)

- **H-1**: The PR deletes the only "strict" merge-time verification mode of the audit-chain verifier (`verify_for_merge`/`LOA_AUDIT_STRICT_VERIFY`), silently downgrading every caller — including any merge gate that relied on it — to permissive trust semantics (accepts `BOOTSTRAP-PENDING` trust-stores, accepts unpinned local `.pub` key fallback). No way to confirm from this diff whether a live caller depended on the strict path.
- **M-1**: `spiral-evidence.sh`'s bare-path deliverable matcher loses its backtick-span masking, reopening the false-positive class that the code's own adjacent comment (issue #1175) warns "invit[es] stub/symlink forgery" — but the fix was only ever applied to the guarded pattern, not this one.
- **M-2**: `semver-bump.sh` drops prerelease-tag validation but keeps a glob that still matches prerelease tags, so a legacy prerelease tag can now crash version resolution instead of being safely filtered out.
